correctness.rationale: A complete 16-vertex face enumeration has 2712 nonempty faces and an independent 65536-mask cross-check. Precisely 999 verified elementary free-face pairs leave a four-dimensional simplicial subcomplex with 0..4 face counts (16,98,243,255,102). Exact signed integer boundary matrices reduce by unit unimodular pivots only, with ranks (15,83,153,101), yielding torsion-free homology ranks (1,0,7,1,1) and zero otherwise. Independently, all original mod-two boundaries square to zero and have Betti ranks (1,0,7,1,1,0,0,0); seven independent degree-two cocycles evaluated via Alexander-Whitney against a nonbounding four-cycle give a zero 7x7 pairing. Full self-contained source and explicit certificate reproduced their expected output; algebraic elimination is not misrepresented as a topological collapse. No general-parameter homotopy statement is asserted.

value.rationale: The precise \(n=4k=16\) case is the first excluded circumference from a 2026 uniform \(n\ge4k+1\) sphere-mapping-torus theorem and is therefore a motivated sharp boundary rather than an arbitrary finite sample. The fully determined integral homology and mod-two cohomology ring reveal a concrete structural failure of extension: the stable even fourth-power family has first homology Z, no second homology, and nonzero \(H^1\smile H^3\), while this boundary case has \(H_1=0\), \(H_2\cong\mathbb Z^7\), and no positive mod-two products. These exact reusable data can guide a future optimal stable-range/exceptional-case classification. The result intentionally does not assert any unproved homotopy decomposition.
